fee_notes: Marketing split: 1.5% System Marketing Fee (brand fund) + 0.5% Local Marketing Fee = 2.0% total. Technology Fee $145-$165/user/year (2-15 typical users), capped at $10,000/year; too variable to express as single monthly figure. No royalty minimum floor stated.
raw_excerpt: Ongoing Franchise Fee: 8% of Gross Sales. Local Marketing Fee: 0.5% of Gross Sales. System Marketing Fee: 1.5% of Gross Sales. Technology Fee: currently $145 to $165 per user account per year, with a typical Warehouse having between 2 and 15 user accounts.
